description: An Active row of the BIWW Allocations custom table giving the declared sales rep a remaining allotment of at least the quantity for one product variant; created per test and deleted at teardown. Story BMP-94.

owner.description: ZnodeUser.UserId of the sales rep: link it to the test's declared account (@user.userId), never a username

ownerEmail.description: E-mail of the same rep (allotments link to the rep only through SalesRepEmail): link it as @user.email

parentSku.description: SKU of the configurable parent product, linked from the product need, e.g. @product.parentProductSku

childSku.description: SKU of the variant the allotment is for, linked from the product need, e.g. @product.variant1Sku

quantity.description: Units the test redeems; the allotment is created with QuantityAllocated = QuantityRemaining = quantity
